title: Integration Development Lead
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Senior Data Integration Developer - Consultant
  
Gallagher Bassett is searching for a meticulous and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our talented team.
  
To succeed in this role, you must be able to conceive and portray the data picture. These individual initiates,
  
evaluate, and influences projects, he or she is involved from the perspective of the entire organization. The ideal
  
candidate will also have proven experience in data integration and data analysis, with excellent analytical,
  
communication, and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
Job Qualifications:
  

* 7+ years’ experience in building scalable enterprise data integration solutions; preferred on the Microsoft

SQL Server and any MPP System (Teradata, Netezza etc.) Prefer Azure Data Warehouse/Database
  
platforms.
  

* Proficiency with data integration tools such as SISS and Azure Data Factory (ADF), in-depth hands-on

experience with SQL, TSQL, and data formats such as XML and JSON.
  

* Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Github
* In-depth understanding of data integration, data quality, and multi-dimensional design.
* Proven experience with implementing data warehouse architecture standards, processes, and

methodologies.
  

* Excellent organizational and analytical abilities with problem solving skills.
* Able to hit the ground running with a can-do attitude, curious.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to collaborate with cross-functional

teams

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

Responsibilities:
  

* Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software.
* Design and implement effective and scalable solutions to store and retrieve organization data.
* Responsible for the architecture, modeling, design, development, testing, implementation and

maintenance of the data engineering routines and structures which populate and grow our databases,
  
data marts and tables.
  

* Develop data flows that can leverage both on premise and cloud architectures.
* Work with stakeholders including the business analytics teams and IS architecture teams to assist with

data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.

  
  
**About you**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant field.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

### **Senior Data Engineer – ServiceNow to Salesforce Data Migration**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze and understand ServiceNow and Salesforce data models.
* Design end-to-end data migration strategy, mapping, and transformation rules.
* Extract, cleanse, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) data from ServiceNow into Salesforce.
* Build scalable migration pipelines using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Talend, SSIS, Python, or MuleSoft.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, reconciliation, and validation during migration.
* Handle large-volume data loads using Salesforce Bulk API and related integration mechanisms.
* Develop data migration scripts, automation frameworks, and monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Salesforce architects, and functional teams to validate migrated data.
* Manage data security, governance, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Troubleshoot migration issues and optimize performance.
* Support cutover planning, mock migrations, and production deployments.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong SQL and database expertise (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, etc.).
* Experience with ServiceNow tables, CMDB, Incident, Change, Asset, and related modules.
* Experience with Salesforce objects, relationships, Data Loader, Bulk API, and Salesforce platform architecture.
* ETL/ELT tools and data integration frameworks.
* Python, Spark, or other data engineering technologies.
* Data profiling, cleansing, and master data management.
* Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years in data engineering and migration projects.
* Multiple large-scale enterprise data migration implementations.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Salesforce integrations.
* Knowledge of Agile project delivery and DevOps practices.

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

title: Product Engineer
description:
About Nutcracklab

Nutcracklab is an AI analytics company building intelligent products that help businesses make better decisions using data, predictive analytics and artificial intelligence.We are building a portfolio of AI\-driven products across multiple business domains and are looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to help take these products from MVP and prototype stages into reliable, production\-ready systems.

Required SkillsMust Have

· **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**

· Strong **Python** development skills

· Strong **SQL** skills

· Experience with **PostgreSQL** or equivalent relational databases

· Experience building **REST APIs**

· Experience with **FastAPI, Flask, Django or equivalent**

· Strong experience with **Pandas / NumPy**

· Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics or AI applications

· Experience with **Git/GitHub**

· Experience with **Docker**

· Experience deploying applications to a cloud environment

· Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills

· Understanding of software architecture and production engineering practices

Preferred

· Experience with **Microsoft Azure**

· Azure ML or equivalent ML deployment experience

· Experience with **Streamlit**

· Data engineering / ETL

· API and third\-party system integrations

· CI/CD and GitHub Actions

· Application monitoring and logging

· Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture

· Experience taking products from **prototype/MVP → production**

· Experience working in **retail, e\-commerce or other data\-intensive business domains**

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

· Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Can independently investigate and solve technical problems.

· Is comfortable working with incomplete or evolving requirements.

· Can make practical architecture and technology decisions.

· Can balance speed of delivery with engineering quality.

· Enjoys working across multiple technical areas rather than being restricted to one narrow function.

· Has strong product thinking in addition to coding ability.

· Is comfortable working directly with founders and customers.

· Is excited by the opportunity to build new products from the ground up.

Why Join Nutcracklab?

This is an early\-stage opportunity with significant technical ownership.

You will have the opportunity to:

· Build AI products from the ground up.

· Work directly with the founder.

· Influence architecture and technology decisions.

· Work across AI, data and product engineering.

· Take products from **idea → prototype → MVP → production**.

· Help establish the company’s engineering culture and technical foundation.

· Eventually help build and lead the engineering team as the product portfolio grows.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
